Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.



WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base



REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.



WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability



READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.



Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.


Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: UX Research Analyst - Contract
description:
This is a 3-month contract role. Contract extension is not guaranteed, but may occur dependent on performance, company work volume, and budget.


Pulse Labs  is empowering insights and elevating experiences for the world's top technology companies. Backed by investors including Google and Amazon, we're revolutionizing product development delivering human-centered, actionable insights at every stage of the product lifecycle from inception to market release and beyond. We empower top tech companies to create and refine paradigm-shifting mobile, smart home, and AI products.


If you thrive in a fast-paced multi-project environment and love analyzing qualitative data, then you're a perfect fit. You'll work directly with our researchers to execute qualitative research projects such as diary studies, focus groups, IDIs, longitudinal panel studies, etc. 


You will be a team-player who is an integral member of a talented and dedicated group of researchers working in a fast-paced, rapid-response environment where rigor and quality are paramount. Using Pulse Labs' proprietary tools and platforms, you’ll dive deep into rich video and survey data to analyze and interpret users’ interactions with and perceptions about next-gen products.


This is a 100% remote Brazil-based contract position. Occasionally, you will be required to work after standard work hours, including weekends.


If interested, please email your resume to


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with UX researchers to understand research projects, including customer requirements, timelines, analysis plan, and business goals.
  • Assist project team members with the logistical operations of the research program, such as maintaining research timelines, project schedules, question banks, data repositories, and other research-related artifacts.
  • Work closely with the operations team to make sure collected data matches the study requirements.
  • Ensure sound research methods while assisting with initial project plans, analyses, and creating final reports for clients.
  • Analyze responses from participant videos and transcripts, surveys, and other study data to develop key research findings and recommendations for clients.
  • Under the guidance of UX researchers, create deliverables for clients including scorecards, toplines, reports, and slide decks.
  • Develop high quality data visualizations, communicating data and findings cleanly, effectively, and efficiently.
  • Collaborate with the team and across the company to improve our internal processes.
  • Provide feedback to the Design and Engineering teams about how to improve our proprietary platform.


 Basic Qualifications

  • 2-6 years of experience working as an analyst in a research setting or in a similar detail-oriented production environment at a tech company.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese with clear written and verbal communications in both.
  • Knowledge of the end-to-end research lifecycle, including research methods/approaches and common analyses, specifically those related to UX.
  • Expertise with data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Experience working on a team of researchers as well as alongside operations personnel in a rapid-response, often ambiguous environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.
  • High attention to detail and ability to recognize patterns and anomalies in qualitative and/or quantitative data.
  • Collaborative attitude and ability to foster a positive work environment.
  • Very comfortable using emerging technologies and different software systems. 
  • High comfort working with Google Docs, Google Sheets, or similar products.
  • Undergraduate degree in psychology, research methods, human computer interaction, sociology, or related field. 


Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous work in a consulting environment conducting research for commercial clients.
  • Previous work with early-to-mid stage startups and/or FAANG or other top tech companies.

description:
This is a 3-month contract role. Contract extension is not guaranteed, but may occur dependent on performance, company work volume, and budget.


Pulse Labs  is empowering insights and elevating experiences for the world's top technology companies. Backed by investors including Google and Amazon, we're revolutionizing product development delivering human-centered, actionable insights at every stage of the product lifecycle from inception to market release and beyond. We empower top tech companies to create and refine paradigm-shifting mobile, smart home, and AI products.


If you thrive in a fast-paced multi-project environment and love analyzing qualitative data, then you're a perfect fit. You'll work directly with our researchers to execute qualitative research projects such as diary studies, focus groups, IDIs, longitudinal panel studies, etc. 


You will be a team-player who is an integral member of a talented and dedicated group of researchers working in a fast-paced, rapid-response environment where rigor and quality are paramount. Using Pulse Labs' proprietary tools and platforms, you’ll dive deep into rich video and survey data to analyze and interpret users’ interactions with and perceptions about next-gen products.


This is a 100% remote Brazil-based contract position. Occasionally, you will be required to work after standard work hours, including weekends.


If interested, please email your resume to


Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with UX researchers to understand research projects, including customer requirements, timelines, analysis plan, and business goals.
  • Assist project team members with the logistical operations of the research program, such as maintaining research timelines, project schedules, question banks, data repositories, and other research-related artifacts.
  • Work closely with the operations team to make sure collected data matches the study requirements.
  • Ensure sound research methods while assisting with initial project plans, analyses, and creating final reports for clients.
  • Analyze responses from participant videos and transcripts, surveys, and other study data to develop key research findings and recommendations for clients.
  • Under the guidance of UX researchers, create deliverables for clients including scorecards, toplines, reports, and slide decks.
  • Develop high quality data visualizations, communicating data and findings cleanly, effectively, and efficiently.
  • Collaborate with the team and across the company to improve our internal processes.
  • Provide feedback to the Design and Engineering teams about how to improve our proprietary platform.


 Basic Qualifications

  • 2-6 years of experience working as an analyst in a research setting or in a similar detail-oriented production environment at a tech company.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Portuguese with clear written and verbal communications in both.
  • Knowledge of the end-to-end research lifecycle, including research methods/approaches and common analyses, specifically those related to UX.
  • Expertise with data collection, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Experience working on a team of researchers as well as alongside operations personnel in a rapid-response, often ambiguous environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.
  • High attention to detail and ability to recognize patterns and anomalies in qualitative and/or quantitative data.
  • Collaborative attitude and ability to foster a positive work environment.
  • Very comfortable using emerging technologies and different software systems. 
  • High comfort working with Google Docs, Google Sheets, or similar products.
  • Undergraduate degree in psychology, research methods, human computer interaction, sociology, or related field. 


Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous work in a consulting environment conducting research for commercial clients.
  • Previous work with early-to-mid stage startups and/or FAANG or other top tech companies.

title: Notion Expert
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Notion specialist to design, implement, and optimize a comprehensive workspace that will serve as our central hub for contacts, data management, and team workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Audit our current processes and recommend a scalable Notion structure.
  • Build and customize databases for large volumes of contacts and information.
  • Create clear, intuitive dashboards for day-to-day use and reporting.
  • Integrate Notion with other tools (Google Workspace, automation platforms, etc.).
  • Develop best-practice guidelines and train the team to maintain and update the workspace.


Requirements

  • Proven track record setting up advanced Notion systems for teams or businesses.
  • Strong understanding of database design, automation, and cross-platform integrations.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and deliver a polished final product.


Engagement

  • Freelance or short-term contract (remote).
  • Flexible start date; estimated project length to be discussed.


If you have the skills and creativity to build an efficient, scalable Notion workspace, please send your portfolio or examples of previous Notion projects along with a brief introduction.

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Contact Center Executive - Customer Service
description:
About Us:


HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. This opportunity is open to candidates currently residing in Jundiaí .


Role Overview

The primary responsibility of this role is to assist clients—including tour operators, travel agencies, and end customers—with their inquiries, liaise with suppliers, and manage bookings in alignment with the standards and procedures of the Operations Department. Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with callers in a professional and enthusiastic manner, representing HBX Group with excellence.
  • Provide accurate and helpful information in response to client inquiries.
  • Document all call activity clearly and accurately in the Back Office system.
  • Respond promptly and precisely to online and email requests.
  • Monitor and manage bookings, including reservations, special requests, amendments, and cancellations.
  • Escalate issues appropriately, following Contact Center protocols.
  • Maintain high standards of service quality and professionalism.
  • Meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

  • Follow assigned schedules and adapt to changes based on call volume.

  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).

  • Problem-solving mindset with persistence in resolving issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions independently.
  • High attention to detail and adaptability.
  • Consistent focus and enthusiasm throughout the work shift.


If you are passionate about customer service, communication, and creative problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today!


Note: Only candidates currently living in Jundiaí will be considered for this position in the Hybrid Model.

title: Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce)
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce) who will be responsible for developing complex business needs and providing technical solutions for our Salesforce ecosystem. This person should be flexible to adopt or learn new tools to map the growing business processes as the need arises. This role will report into IT Business Systems team. This role will help positively impact our commercial sales, marketing, agronomy, finance, supply chain, IT & other key business functions with smart, forward-looking solutions and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer, design, develop & support Salesforce Platform (Sales, Service, Marketing/Pardot, Experience Cloud)
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), experience building Custom User Interface, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components.
  • Design and develop sites using Experience Site Builder and customization of experience site interface.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, approval flows as fits the business needs and prepare solution design documents, data flow diagrams, test cases etc. as needed.
  • Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development.
  • Work directly with business (Commercial Sales & Marketing, Agronomy) understanding the business requirements & provide timely and apt solutions.
  • Closely work with extended IT team developers to design, develop, test, implement & support system solutions primarily in Salesforce Platform.


Qualifications and Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on development & design experience with Salesforce Platform is a MUST
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, and Information Systems is preferred

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Assistant will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Sales Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Sales Assistant will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java Spring Boot | Ruby on Rails | Angular)

Experience: 7+ years

Work location: Heredia, Costa Rica & remote for LATAM

English Required: B2+ - C1

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Java Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular to lead complex application development initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a strong technical contributor with a proven track record in building scalable, high-performance systems. While excelling in backend implementation and frontend execution. This role is ideal for a technically strong developer who is ready to expand their impact beyond code delivery into collaborative leadership, stakeholder communication, and architectural decision-making.

Require Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Java Spring Boot and core Java (OOP, data structures, algorithms).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and full-stack web development.
  • Proven experience with Angular and modern frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, and deployment automation tools.
  • Effective communication across global teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end development of scalable, secure, and maintainable applications using Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular .
  • Deliver high-quality code with a strong emphasis on performance, security, and clean architecture .
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA teams, and other team members to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and standardization across teams.
  • Represent technical solutions and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies in project planning and execution.
  • Contribute to migration projects, system modernization, and platform upgrades with minimal disruption.

title: Paid Ads Specialist (Meta & Google) – Remote (LATAM)
description:
GrowthAssistant is looking for a data-driven and proactive Paid Ads Specialist who thrives on performance marketing. If you have strong expertise in Meta and Google Ads campaign management, optimization, and reporting, this is your chance to join a fast-growing U.S.-based team where your work will directly impact the growth of exciting brands.


This isn’t just another ads role—it’s an opportunity to sharpen your skills across multiple paid media channels, collaborate with an international marketing team, and continuously grow in a performance-first environment.


If you’re passionate about turning data into action and scaling campaigns to the next level, we want to meet you.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary (based on experience)
  • 100% Remote work setup
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Performance, Attendance & Referral Bonuses
  • Paid Holidays & Time Off
  • Supportive, growth-oriented culture


What You’ll Do

  • Build and launch Meta ad campaigns from scratch while managing Google Search, PMax Shopping, and YouTube campaigns.
  • Analyze ROAS, CTR, CPM, and other KPIs to optimize campaign performance.
  • Run A/B tests and iterate on creatives, ad copy, and audience targeting.
  • Create and maintain performance reports in Excel/Google Sheets (formulas, charts, pivot tables).
  • Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to gather assets and share data-backed recommendations.
  • Proactively communicate with clients via Slack, email, and video calls.
  • Assist in testing emerging platforms and expanding ad strategies.


What We’re Looking For

  • Based in LATAM (Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, etc.).
  • 3+ years of experience with Meta Ads—proven track record of scaling campaigns and driving ROI.
  • 1+ year of experience with Google Ads (Search, PMax Shopping, YouTube).
  • Strong knowledge of paid media KPIs (ROAS, CTR, CPM).
  • Advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards).
  • Hands-on experience managing ad budgets and daily optimizations.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken).
  • Proactive communicator—comfortable using Slack, email, and client video calls.
  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based clients.
  • Availability to work PST hours (CST/EST overlap considered).


Nice to Have

  • Agency or multi-brand experience.
  • E-commerce/DTC background.
  • TikTok Ads experience.
  • Familiarity with creative analysis and performance recommendations.


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.


Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes  Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

title: Full Stack Developer (UI/UX)
description:
Estamos procurando um(a) Full Stack Developer (UI/UX) altamente qualificado(a) para atuar em um projeto global com foco no desenvolvimento de ferramentas e plataformas de design.   • Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git).
  • Compreensão de princípios de UX e design centrado no usuário.
  • Conhecimento básico de Figma.
  • Experiência com Google Ads ou plataformas relacionadas.

As an operations specialist, you will monitor ongoing deliveries and assist delivery drivers and shippers over the phone and live chat.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior (Python / CrewAI / N8N)
description:
Engenheiro de Dados e Software (IA & Automação Inteligente)


A Mouts TI é especializada em entregar soluções tecnológicas sob medida, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes empresas com agilidade, qualidade e foco em resultados.


Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados e Software para atuar em projetos estratégicos de um dos nossos maiores clientes, uma empresa global, líder em seu segmento , que vem investindo fortemente em inovação e tecnologias de dados em larga escala.


O profissional será responsável por projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, integrando dados, APIs e automações inteligentes em um ambiente moderno e dinâmico.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados e APIs escaláveis , garantindo desempenho e qualidade.
  • Atuar com Azure Data Factory , Databricks e Apache Airflow na orquestração de fluxos de dados.
  • Programar em Python , PySpark , TypeScript e JavaScript , aplicando boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Implementar integrações entre sistemas utilizando REST e GraphQL .
  • Criar automações inteligentes com N8N , CrewIA e LangChain .
  • Adotar práticas modernas de DevOps , com testes automatizados , CI/CD , Docker e Kubernetes .



Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados e desenvolvimento de software .
  • Domínio de Azure , Databricks , PySpark e ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Proficiência em Python e conhecimento em .NET , FastAPI ou Express .
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software , Clean Code , DDD e SOLID .
  • Desejável experiência com integrações de IA generativa , como CrewIA e OpenAI APIs .


✨ Aqui, valorizamos pessoas curiosas, colaborativas e com vontade de ir além. Se você busca desafios reais e projetos com propósito, seu lugar pode ser na Mouts!

title: Bolsista Graduado - Grupo Boticário - DTM.Digital – Plataforma digital| Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: DTM.Digital – Plataforma digital


Sobre a Oportunidade:


Inovação e tecnologia são forças que movem o Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

Estamos em busca de um talento analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento fullstack de uma nova plataforma de gestão industrial, um projeto estratégico que conectará dados, inteligência artificial e eficiência operacional.

Essa solução será a base para modelos preditivos de detecção de anomalias, permitindo a otimização proativa dos processos fabris e a melhoria contínua da performance industrial.

Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à inovação, onde poderá aplicar tecnologia para gerar impacto real na indústria, essa oportunidade é para você.


Formação Acadêmica: Análise de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia de Computação ou similares


Principais Atividades:

  • Auxiliar a liderar projetos inovadores em colaboração com times de negócio, atuando desde a fase de discovery até a implementação final.
  • Desenvolver iniciativas e sistemas que impulsionem a evolução da indústria do Grupo Boticário.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas para sistemas industriais e produtos digitais, considerando os requisitos de infraestrutura e redes.
  • Codificar e desenvolver sistemas, integrações e aplicações web que suportam e otimizam as operações industriais.
  • Desenhar e implementar integrações robustas entre diferentes sistemas industriais.
  • Estabelecer e manter a governança de sistemas industriais, garantindo a conformidade e as boas práticas.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (operações, projetos, automação e manutenção) em discussões técnicas e funcionais.
  • Manter bom relacionamento buscando soluções inovadoras para os projetos, trabalhando de forma colaborativa e usando de boa comunicação.
  • Investigar e usar novas tecnologias quando relevante para os desafios do setor.
  • Promover e contribuir com refinamentos técnicos e funcionais junto à equipe.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e mentoria para outros membros do time.


Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Experiência como Back-end (preferencialmente em Node.JS).
  • Conhecimentos em Python, SQL e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e no desenvolvimento de APIs REST.
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS e GCP), incluindo o uso de serviços serverless (AWS Lambda).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes para orquestração de containers.
  • Experiência em CI/CD e versionamento de código (GitHub, com GitHub Copilot sendo um diferencial).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como PostgreSQL e MySQL.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoria (APM e Logs), como New Relic e Grafana.
  • Conhecimento em Clean Architecture e programação orientada a objetos ou funcional.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e arquitetura orientada a eventos (pub/sub).
  • Atuação em squads ágeis de produtos digitais, com experiência em colocar soluções em produção.
  • Pensamento analítico e criativo para desenvolver soluções que atendam diferentes tipos de necessidade.
  • Grande capacidade de aprendizado de novas práticas, tecnologias e linguagens de programação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional, multi-linguagem e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma.
  • Pragmatismo para resolução de problemas.



Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa, Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar, Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, boa comunicação.


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Graduado) R$3.500,00

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Local: São José dos Pinhais – PR

O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolver bolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa.

O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: DTM.Digital – Plataforma digital


Sobre a Oportunidade:


Inovação e tecnologia são forças que movem o Grupo Boticário, e você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

Estamos em busca de um talento analítico e colaborativo para atuar no desenvolvimento fullstack de uma nova plataforma de gestão industrial, um projeto estratégico que conectará dados, inteligência artificial e eficiência operacional.

Essa solução será a base para modelos preditivos de detecção de anomalias, permitindo a otimização proativa dos processos fabris e a melhoria contínua da performance industrial.

Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à inovação, onde poderá aplicar tecnologia para gerar impacto real na indústria, essa oportunidade é para você.


Formação Acadêmica: Análise de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia de Computação ou similares


Principais Atividades:

  • Auxiliar a liderar projetos inovadores em colaboração com times de negócio, atuando desde a fase de discovery até a implementação final.
  • Desenvolver iniciativas e sistemas que impulsionem a evolução da indústria do Grupo Boticário.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas para sistemas industriais e produtos digitais, considerando os requisitos de infraestrutura e redes.
  • Codificar e desenvolver sistemas, integrações e aplicações web que suportam e otimizam as operações industriais.
  • Desenhar e implementar integrações robustas entre diferentes sistemas industriais.
  • Estabelecer e manter a governança de sistemas industriais, garantindo a conformidade e as boas práticas.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (operações, projetos, automação e manutenção) em discussões técnicas e funcionais.
  • Manter bom relacionamento buscando soluções inovadoras para os projetos, trabalhando de forma colaborativa e usando de boa comunicação.
  • Investigar e usar novas tecnologias quando relevante para os desafios do setor.
  • Promover e contribuir com refinamentos técnicos e funcionais junto à equipe.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e mentoria para outros membros do time.


Conhecimentos Necessários:

  • Experiência como Back-end (preferencialmente em Node.JS).
  • Conhecimentos em Python, SQL e análise de dados.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e no desenvolvimento de APIs REST.
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS e GCP), incluindo o uso de serviços serverless (AWS Lambda).
  • Experiência com Kubernetes para orquestração de containers.
  • Experiência em CI/CD e versionamento de código (GitHub, com GitHub Copilot sendo um diferencial).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como PostgreSQL e MySQL.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoria (APM e Logs), como New Relic e Grafana.
  • Conhecimento em Clean Architecture e programação orientada a objetos ou funcional.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e arquitetura orientada a eventos (pub/sub).
  • Atuação em squads ágeis de produtos digitais, com experiência em colocar soluções em produção.
  • Pensamento analítico e criativo para desenvolver soluções que atendam diferentes tipos de necessidade.
  • Grande capacidade de aprendizado de novas práticas, tecnologias e linguagens de programação.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional, multi-linguagem e colaborativo, de maneira autônoma.
  • Pragmatismo para resolução de problemas.



Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e iniciativa, Visão sistêmica e multidisciplinar, Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, boa comunicação.

title: Advogado(a) SR - Compliance e Investigações internas
description:
Qual será a sua ocupação?

Advogado(a) Sênior – Compliance e Investigações Internas.


Local de trabalho: Vaga será para atuar em um dos nossos escritórios

Regime de trabalho: A definir


O que esperamos de você?

Formação em Direito e inscrição ativa na OAB;

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 6 anos) em compliance, investigações internas, governança e riscos;

Conhecimento sólido em Lei Anticorrupção, legislação de PLD/FT e boas práticas internacionais ;

Excelente comunicação, capacidade analítica e visão estratégica;

Inglês avançado/fluente.

Bom relacionamento interpessoal;


Quais serão os seus desafios?

Estruturar, implementar e monitorar Programas de Integridade e Compliance;

Desenvolver e revisar políticas internas relacionadas a integridade, PLD/FT e controles internos;

Conduzir investigações internas e elaborar relatórios de resultados, recomendações e planos de ação;

Elaborar pareceres jurídicos sobre temas de integridade, compliance, anticorrupção e PLD/FT (Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e ao Financiamento do Terrorismo);

Realizar due diligence de terceiros e processos de KYC, com foco em mitigação de riscos de integridade;

Apoiar clientes na obtenção de selos de integridade (ex.: Pró-Ética e Mais Integridade), desde a fase de diagnóstico até a submissão final;

Promover treinamentos e workshops em compliance, PLD/FT e cultura ética;

Interagir com reguladores e stakeholders estratégicos, oferecendo suporte técnico e estratégico.

Atuar em Processos Administrativos de Responsabilização (PAR);


Quais serão as suas recompensas?

MUITAS, queremos todos felizes e realizados!

Vale refeição;

Descontos em restaurantes parceiros;

Vale transporte;

Plano de saúde;

Plano odontológico;

Bolsa de estudos;

Wellhub (Gympass);

PPR;

Seguro de vida;

Prêmio por tempo de casa;

Folga de aniversário;

Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico com recursos modernos.


Todas as nossas oportunidades estão disponíveis para ambos os sexos e pessoas com deficiência.

title: Senior BackEnd Engineer (Typescript)
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior BackEnd Engineer with a deep understanding of Typescript programming, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities


  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Technology Requirements


  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer.
  • Proficient in Typescript, NestJS and Relational and Non-Relational Databases.
  • 2+ years of experience deploying and running code on AWS Lambda, with hands-
  • on experience using DynamoDB and RDS
  • Strong understanding of clean code principles and separation of concerns
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, and Kubernetes for development and deployment.
  • Experience with Python and/or Kotlin Multiplatform is a plus.


Profile Requirements


  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.
  • Experience in frontend development is a plus.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries.


Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years. Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.

#welcometoyourfuture


What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or similar areas
  • 5+ years of professional experience with .NET (C#)
  • Strong hands-on experience with React.js
  • Familiarity with cloud services (e.g., Azure, AWS) and microservices architecture is a big plus
  • Experience with REST APIs and modern software development practices
  • Solid understanding of software design, testing, and version control
  • English proficiency (B2 or higher)
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal — we’ll support you!


What we value in you

  • The drive to go beyond expectations — both yours and ours
  • Curiosity and a hunger to grow technically and professionally
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills — you're a team player, not a lone wolf
  • Proactivity, autonomy, and composure under pressure
  • A quality-first mindset and strong sense of ownership
  • Flexibility and adaptability — things change, you evolve
  • A passion for innovation in a fast-moving market


What you’ll love about Affinity

  • Working in a company that dares to disrupt the tech landscape
  • A people-first culture built around simplicity, relationships, and efficiency
  • A performance-based career path — your growth is in your hands
  • A real shot at joining our permanent staff and growing with us long-term

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
We are a collective group of fearless people with a clear purpose: to empower professionals around the world through intelligent workflow automation software. Currently, more than 500 people across 7 countries work with us, remotely or in a hybrid way, to make life easier for over 3,000 companies using Pipefy in more than 180 countries. Since our founding in 2015, we have put people at the center of everything we do, so we invite you to learn more about this position and apply to be part of our team.


Job Description:


We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst with a focus on Business Intelligence, Analytics, and Insights. The ideal candidate will have solid experience in data analysis, with a strong understanding of tools such as SQL and Python. The primary goal is to be able to translate data into actionable insights, supporting strategic decision-making across different business areas such as Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market. Familiarity with data visualization tools (such as Tableau) is desirable.


The professional will be responsible for leading complex data analysis projects, presenting results, and collaborating with different stakeholders to enhance the company's data strategy. Experience in data storytelling is essential, ensuring that insights are communicated and documented clearly and effectively.


* It is important to note that this opportunity is not related to data engineering.


Responsibilities:


- Conduct advanced data analyses to generate insights into business performance, trends, and growth opportunities;

- Communicate insights and strategic recommendations through presentations and data narratives (data storytelling), facilitating decision-making processes;

- Collaborate with different business areas to understand needs and translate business questions into clear and objective data analyses;

- Share knowledge and experience with the entire Data team, fostering technical collaboration and helping to increase the department's data maturity.


Requirements:


- Experience in a data analysis role;

- Strong communication skills;

- Advanced SQL and proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Scikit-learn);

- Apply quantitative techniques to generate business insights;

- Ability to work with cross-functional teams, especially Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams;

- Familiarity with data visualization tools (such as Tableau) is desirable.


Benefits:


- Health and Dental Plan

- Individual Life Insurance

- Flexible Hours (in compliance with daily work hours)

- Flexible Meal/Food Allowance

- Home Office Support

- Furniture Assistance

- Psychological Support (for you or legal dependents)

- Wellhub

- Extended Maternity and Paternity Leave

- School/Nanny Allowance

- Supplemental Nutrition Assistance

- Veterinary Plan

- Birthday Day Off

- Marriage Leave (7 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Loved Ones (10 days)

- Bereavement Leave for Adoption or Pet Loss (2 days)

- Individual Funeral Assistance

- Monthly Education Support

- Payroll Loan

- Financial Consulting

- Udemy Corporate Access

- Coworking Space

- Pipefy License for up to 10 Users

title: Desenvolvedor Android (Remoto)
description:
Vaga 100% remotaPJ
Responsabilidades:Desenvolver e manter aplicativos Android de alta qualidade, utilizando Kotlin e Java;Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos aplicativos com base em métricas como a nota na Play Store, identificando e solucionando problemas para melhorar a experiência do usuário;Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir requisitos e desenvolver novos produtos e funcionalidades, promovendo a inovação contínua;Atuar proativamente na observação das plataformas de produção, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e implementando soluções para garantir eficiência e estabilidade dos sistemas.
Requisitos:Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento Android com Kotlin e Java;Conhecimento em Jetpack Components, como Compose e Navigation;Vivência com desenvolvimento de testes unitários e instrumentados;Domínio de ferramentas de injeção de dependência (Koin, Dagger, Dagger2, Hilt);Familiaridade com arquiteturas móveis como MVVM e MVI;Entendimento básico de processos de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, entre outros);Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro (tradicional ou cripto).

title: Desenvolvedor Servicenow Pl
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


O que esperamos que você realize:

  • Desenvolver aplicações escopadas (Scoped Apps) utilizando App Engine Studio.
  • Criar e manter workflows e automações com Flow Designer.
  • Implementar Business Rules, Script Includes e lógica de negócio avançada.
  • Construir interfaces de usuário com UI Builder para uso em Workspaces.
  • Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e reutilização de componentes.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência com ServiceNow.
  • Experiência com App Engine, Flow Designer, UI Builder e Workspaces.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento e documentação.
  • Domínio de JavaScript e estrutura da plataforma ServiceNow.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações CSA, App Engine Developer.
  • Experiência com integração via REST/SOAP APIs e design centrado no usuário.


O que te oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 53201


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


O que você deve ter?


- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Especialista de Tecnologia – Dados & Analytics
description:
Será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar processos de coleta, tratamento e análise de grandes volumes de dados, transformando informações em insights estratégicos que apoiem a tomada de decisão em todas as áreas da empresa. Atuará com ferramentas de Data Warehousing, Data Factory e Power BI, assegurando a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados corporativos, além de acompanhar tendências como o Microsoft Fabric.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a coleta, transformação e integração de dados provenientes de múltiplas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de ETL e pipelines de dados;
  • Estruturar e manter ambientes de dados (Data Lake, Data Warehouse) garantindo desempenho, governança e escalabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar conjuntos de dados e modelos analíticos para relatórios e dashboards interativos no Power BI;
